changes.oldText: The Dashboard entry opens a board of cards scoped to the selected project: Session Status, Pending Sessions and Reasons, Long-running Sessions, Resource Allocation, Deployments, Project Folders, Project Users, and Audit Log. Select a row in Pending Sessions and Reasons to open that session's scheduling history.
